unit_labour_costs.note: 由上季 -0.7% 翻正至 +0.5%，年增亦 +0.5%，勞動成本壓力再起
unit_labour_costs._src: ABS Australian National Accounts: National Income, Expenditure and Product, March 2026（2026-06-03 發布）『March quarter key figures』表 Productivity 區塊：Real unit labour costs，Dec 25 to Mar 26 = 0.5、Through the year Mar 25 to Mar 26 = 0.5。ABS 的 RULC_LAB 序列停在 2018-Q3，此數字只在新聞稿表格公布，不進 SDMX API，故每季國民所得帳發布後（3/6/9/12 月上旬）需人工更新一次
